name: Canvas Area UI
description: Canvas area DOM structure, interactions, and visual states for the infinite canvas engine.

dom.style: position: relative; overflow: hidden; width: 100%; height: 100%

elements.plugin-list-panel: .pli-zone — Lower-left hover zone (position: fixed, bottom: 8px, left: 8px). Contains .pli-icon (◣ character) and .plugin-list-panel (scrollable list of all card names with focus/terminate right-click options).
elements.arrange-panel: .prr-zone — Lower-right hover zone (position: fixed, bottom: 8px, right: 8px). Contains .prr-icon (◢ character) and .arr-panel with Auto Arrange button, Tile Plugins with custom W×H inputs (grid units), and Snap Origin button.
elements.origin-dot: .origin-dot — Center indicator dot at world origin (0,0). Visible only when no cards are open or at zoom levels where origin is visible.
elements.layout-overlays: .layout-overlay[data-zone] × 8 — Drop zone overlays with SVG previews, shown during locked-mode card drag at 1x scale. Zones: top-left, top, top-right, left, right, bottom-left, bottom, bottom-right.
elements.status-bar: .status-bar — Bottom bar with zoom percentage (click to toggle lock), lock/unlock icon, workspace name, reset-zoom icon (visible when scale != 1), and View All button.

interactions.name: pan_blank
interactions.trigger: mousedown (button 0 or 1) on empty canvas area or Ctrl+drag anywhere
interactions.gesture: mousemove on document → mouseup on document
interactions.action: delta panX = mouse delta, delta panY = mouse delta → scheduleTransform (RAF batched CSS transform update on all cards)

interactions.name: zoom_wheel
interactions.trigger: wheel on canvas (not over cards — target is #canvas or non-card element)
interactions.action: scale *= 1 + deltaY * 0.001 → clamp scale 0.1–5.0 → cursor-centered pan: panX = mouseX - worldX * newScale, panY = mouseY - worldY * newScale
interactions.result: Canvas zoom level updated, all card positions recalculated via scheduleTransform

interactions.name: zoom_ctrl_wheel
interactions.action: Same zoom formula as zoom_wheel → stopPropagation to block browser zoom

interactions.name: context_menu_empty
interactions.action: Show ContextMenu with items: View All, Auto Arrange
interactions.result: Context menu appears at click position with canvas-specific actions

interactions.name: add_terminal
interactions.trigger: TopBar New Terminal button or Ctrl+J shortcut
interactions.action: addCard (create PluginCard with UUID) → create TerminalPlugin in card body → bringToFront (increment z-index) → panToCard (animated pan to new card position)
interactions.result: New terminal card appears on canvas, focused and visible

interactions.name: add_explorer
interactions.action: addCard → create ExplorerPlugin (FileExplorerPlugin + MonacoEditorPlugin in split layout) → setMarkdownOpeners (bridge markdown openers to file explorer context menus) → bringToFront
interactions.result: New explorer card with file tree and editor panes

interactions.name: add_git
interactions.action: addCard → create GitPlugin in card body → bringToFront
interactions.result: New git card with commit history, staging, and diff views

interactions.name: add_markdown
interactions.action: addCard → create MarkdownPlugin in card body → bringToFront

interactions.name: drag_card
interactions.gesture: mousemove on document → mouseup on document
interactions.action: PluginCard drag with 28px grid snapping (worldX = snap(rawWorldX, 28), worldY = snap(rawWorldY, 28)) → update card CSS transform → overlay layout zones shown when locked at 1x scale

interactions.name: drop_zone
interactions.trigger: drag over .layout-overlay[data-zone] during locked-mode card drag
interactions.action: Calculate drop zone based on data-zone attribute → snap card to zone quadrant position with calculated width/height (half of canvas dimensions for corner zones, full width/height for edge zones)
interactions.result: Card snaps into layout grid zone on mouseup

interactions.name: focus_card
interactions.action: bringToFront → increment z-index counter → set card z-index = counter → rebalance z-indices if counter >= 9998

interactions.name: minimize_card
interactions.action: Set card display: none, isOpen = false → notify onChange callbacks (onTerminalsChanged/onExplorersChanged/onGitChanged/onMarkdownChanged/onSpecsmapChanged) → onStateChange
interactions.result: Card hidden from view but still in cards array

interactions.name: terminate_card
interactions.trigger: card terminate (close) button click or plugin list right-click Terminate
interactions.action: If terminal: IPC terminal:kill (kill PTY session) → remove card DOM element → splice card from cards array → notify onChange callbacks → onStateChange
interactions.result: Card fully removed, associated process/PTY killed

interactions.name: plugin_list
interactions.action: Show .plugin-list-panel with sorted card names → click card name to focus (bringToFront + panToCard) → right-click for context menu with Show and Terminate options
interactions.result: Plugin list panel visible with interactive card list

interactions.name: arrange_panel
interactions.action: Show .arr-panel with Auto Arrange button, Tile Plugins section (custom W×H number inputs in grid units), and Snap Origin button

interactions.name: fit_all
interactions.trigger: View All button click in status bar or context menu item
interactions.action: Calculate bounding box of all open cards → compute scale to fit with 80px margin → animate pan to center of bounding box using ease-out cubic over 300ms
interactions.result: All cards visible and fitted within viewport

interactions.name: status_bar_zoom_toggle
interactions.trigger: click on zoom percentage display in status bar
interactions.action: Toggle locked true/false → fire onLockToggle callback → update lock icon in status bar
interactions.result: Canvas lock state toggled; when locked, zoom/pan disabled except Ctrl+wheel blocked

interactions.name: status_bar_reset_zoom
interactions.trigger: click on reset-zoom icon in status bar
interactions.action: scale = 1.0 → scheduleTransform → update status bar zoom percentage display

states.default: Cards positioned at world coordinates with CSS transform, grid background visible, zoom and pan controls active, status bar shown with current zoom percentage and workspace name.
states.panning: User actively dragging canvas. cursor: grabbing on #canvas. All card positions updating in real-time via scheduleTransform as mouse moves.
states.locked: Zoom/pan disabled — mousewheel and mousedown pan on canvas suppressed. Ctrl+wheel still blocked with stopPropagation. Lock icon shown in status bar. Layout drop zones visible when scale is 1x.
states.overlays-visible: Lock mode active at 1x scale. All 8 .layout-overlay[data-zone] drop zone elements visible with SVG preview borders. Shown during card drag in locked mode.
states.empty: No cards open on canvas. Only .origin-dot visible at world origin. Grid pattern still rendered. Empty context menu provides View All and Auto Arrange (both no-op when no cards).
states.zoomed: Scale != 1.0. Reset-zoom icon visible in status bar. Grid pattern scale and position recalculated.

per_card_states.open: Card display: block, isOpen = true. Visible on canvas with header, body content, and resize handles.
per_card_states.minimized: Card display: none, isOpen = false. Hidden from canvas but preserved in cards array for potential reopen.

rendering.canvas_transform: Each card positioned via CSS transform: translate(px, py) on the card element. Transform-origin: 0 0. World-to-screen formula: screenX = worldX * scale + panX, screenY = worldY * scale + panY.
rendering.grid_pattern: CSS background-image on #canvas element set to a canvas-generated dataURL. background-size = patternSize * scale px. background-position = panX px, panY px. Regenerated on grid style change (dots/grid/none).
rendering.card_reposition: scheduleTransform uses requestAnimationFrame batching to update all card CSS transforms. Prevents double-RAF with a pending flag. Called after any pan, zoom, or card position change.
rendering.z_order: Z-index counter increments from 1 on each bringToFront call. When counter reaches 9998, all card z-indices are rebalanced back to sequential values starting from 1.
rendering.animated_pan: Ease-out cubic interpolation over 300ms using requestAnimationFrame loop for smooth pan transitions (fitAll, panToCard).

lifecycle.created_by: App constructor instantiates CanvasArea, which creates the DOM scaffolding and attaches event listeners
lifecycle.destroyed_by: Window close — all event listeners removed, all child cards destroyed
